title: alloy.toml
description: The project file of Alloy. Every key has a default, and an unknown key is an error.

build.title: [build]
build.description: What compiles, and where the output goes.

in.description: The source root. Every `.aly` and `.alx` under it compiles, relative to the folder that holds this file.

out.description: The output root. The tree under `in` is mirrored under it, and the runtime is written beside it as `alloy.luau`.

exclude.description: Glob patterns, relative to `in`, of sources to skip.

clean.description: Delete an output whose source is gone.

artifact.description: Which artifact to write. `ship` runs on Roblox; `check` is what luau-lsp sees, with the types kept.

emit.title: [emit]
emit.description: The few knobs that change what emitted code does.

wait_timeout.description: Seconds passed to every `WaitForChild` that `=>` emits. Unset means no timeout: the engine waits forever and warns after five seconds. With a timeout the call can return nil, so `=>` guards like `->`. The file `alloy init` writes sets five seconds.

std_require.description: The string emitted code passes to `require` for the runtime. Unset means a relative path to the `alloy.luau` the build writes, or the runtime's instance path when the tree holds the file.

erase_type_imports.description: Blank `import type` lines in the output so they add no runtime dependency. The output is then untyped for anyone who analyzes it directly.

lint.title: [lint]
lint.description: Where every lint starts under `alloy flux` and `alloy lint`. `[lint.rules]` then sets one lint or one group. `alloy doc lints` names them.

recommended.description: Apply the level each lint declares. Off, every lint starts at `allow`, and `[lint.rules]` alone turns one on.

strict.description: Turns the pedantic group on, at warn: `implicit_any`, `missing_return_type`, `explicit_any`, `todo_comment`, `print_debug`, `missing_doc`.

deny.description: Deprecated: lints or groups that fail the run. Write `[lint.rules] <name> = "deny"`.

warn.description: Deprecated: lints or groups that print and pass. Write `[lint.rules] <name> = "warn"`.

allow.description: Deprecated: lints or groups that stay silent. Write `[lint.rules] <name> = "allow"`.

rules.title: [lint.rules]
rules.description: The level of one lint: a lint name, a group name (correctness, suspicious, style, complexity, perf, roblox, pedantic, naming, or luau for the type checker's own), an ingot's `<ingot>/<lint>`, or `alx.<name>` for a markup lint. A name beats its group.

correctness.description: The `correctness` group: code that is wrong, or cannot run.

suspicious.description: The `suspicious` group: code that is probably not what the author meant.

style.description: The `style` group: a Luau habit with an Alloy form.

complexity.description: The `complexity` group: a simple thing done in a hard way.

perf.description: The `perf` group: code that runs slower than the plain form.

roblox.description: The `roblox` group: a Roblox API that is deprecated or misused.

pedantic.description: The `pedantic` group: strict rules, on while `[lint] strict = true`.

naming.description: The `naming` group: the case of names, off until `[lint.rules] naming = "warn"`.

luau.description: The `luau` group: the type checker's own reports.

optional_access.description: a value that may be nil is indexed without a guard. Default: `warn`.

needless_assert.description: a `!` on a value the file types as never nil. Default: `warn`.

dropped_result.description: a call of a `Result` function whose value nothing reads. Default: `warn`.

static_call.description: a static of an `impl` called with `:`. Default: `warn`.

argument_count.description: a call passes more arguments than the function takes. Default: `warn`.

unreachable_default.description: a `default` arm after arms that cover every variant. Default: `warn`.

empty_default.description: a `default` arm with an empty body. Default: `warn`.

unused_import.description: an imported name the file never uses. Default: `warn`.

self_assignment.description: `x = x`, an assignment that changes nothing. Default: `warn`.

duplicate_key.description: a table constructor that sets one key twice. Default: `warn`.

misplaced_not.description: `not a == b`, which compares `not a` to `b`. Default: `warn`.

identical_branches.description: an `if` whose `then` and `else` bodies are the same. Default: `warn`.

private_access.description: a private field or method read outside its struct's impl. Default: `warn`.

duplicate_function.description: one name given a `function` body twice. Default: `warn`.

circular_import.description: two files that import each other. Default: `warn`.

deprecated_namespace.description: a use of a namespace declared `@deprecated`. Default: `warn`.

and_or_ternary.description: `c and a or b` in place of a ternary. Default: `warn`.

unused_variable.description: a local that nothing reads. Default: `warn`.

unused_function.description: a function that nothing calls. Default: `warn`.

empty_block.description: an `if`, `else`, or loop body with nothing in it. Default: `warn`.

needless_bool.description: `if c then return true else return false end`. Default: `warn`.

prefer_destroy.description: `delete part` on a plain Instance, where `destroy part` says it. Default: `allow`.

manual_safe_access.description: `a and a.b`, the guard written by hand. Default: `warn`.

manual_coalesce.description: `if x == nil then x = v end`, a coalescing assignment by hand. Default: `warn`.

nil_check_call.description: `if f then f(...) end`, an optional call by hand. Default: `warn`.

manual_type_test.description: `typeof(x) == "T"` in place of `x is T`. Default: `warn`.

array_long_string.description: a long string whose text reads like a nested array. Default: `warn`.

pattern_shadows_local.description: a match pattern that binds the name of a local in scope. Default: `warn`.

match_guard_and.description: a match guard written with `and`. Default: `warn`.

legacy_iterator.description: `pairs` or `ipairs` around a `for ... in` table. Default: `warn`.

manual_floor_div.description: `math.floor(a / b)` in place of `a // b`. Default: `warn`.

manual_push.description: `table.insert` or `table.remove` on a value typed as an Array. Default: `warn`.

concat_interpolation.description: a `..` chain that joins literals and values. Default: `warn`.

raw_require.description: a `require` where an `import` would do. Default: `warn`.

game_alias.description: `"game"` or `"game:X"`, the service path before the alias. Default: `warn`.

manual_class.description: `X.__index = X`, the class idiom by hand. Default: `warn`.

manual_ternary_return.description: `if c then return a else return b end`. Default: `warn`.

redundant_return.description: a bare `return` at the end of a function. Default: `warn`.

local_then_return.description: `local x = v` followed by `return x`. Default: `warn`.

numeric_for_index.description: `for i = 1, #t do local v = t[i]`. Default: `warn`.

too_many_arguments.description: a function with more parameters than `[flux] too_many_arguments`. Default: `warn`.

too_many_lines.description: a function longer than `[flux] too_many_lines`. Default: `warn`.

deep_nesting.description: blocks nested deeper than `[flux] max_nesting`. Default: `warn`.

cognitive_complexity.description: a function whose branches score past `[flux] cognitive_complexity`. Default: `warn`.

collapsible_if.description: `if a then if b then ... end end`. Default: `warn`.

collapsible_else_if.description: `else if ... end end` in place of `elseif`. Default: `warn`.

concat_in_loop.description: `s = s .. x` inside a loop. Default: `warn`.

manual_child_lookup.description: `:FindFirstChild("X")` or `:WaitForChild("X")` with a literal name. Default: `warn`.

instance_new_parent.description: `Instance.new(class, parent)`, the parent as an argument. Default: `warn`.

deprecated_body_mover.description: `BodyVelocity`, `BodyPosition`, `BodyGyro`, and the other body movers. Default: `warn`.

implicit_any.description: a named function parameter, or an empty array literal, with no type. Default: `allow`.

missing_return_type.description: a public function with no return type. Default: `allow`.

const_mutation.description: a write into the value a `const` holds. Default: `allow`.

missing_doc.description: an exported declaration with no comment above it. Default: `allow`.

missing_doc_type.description: an exported `type` alias or `interface` with no comment above it. Default: `allow`.

import_order.description: an `import` under code that runs. Default: `allow`.

camel_case_name.description: a local, function, or parameter in camelCase. Default: `allow`.

type_case.description: a struct, enum, trait, interface, or type not in PascalCase. Default: `allow`.

alx.description: The levels of the markup lints.

static_conditional_child.description: markup in a child expression that no function encloses: it is built once, not on each render. Default: `warn`.

additionalProperties.description: The level of one markup lint.
The level of one lint, one group, or a table of them under a prefix: `alx.static_conditional_child = "warn"`.

oneOf.description: What the lint does when it fires: `allow` is silent, `warn` prints and passes, `deny` prints and fails the run.

additionalProperties.description: What the lint does when it fires: `allow` is silent, `warn` prints and passes, `deny` prints and fails the run.

flux.title: [flux]
flux.description: What `alloy flux` runs beyond the lints, and the limits of the complexity lints. The levels of the lints stay in `[lint]`. `alloy doc flux` explains it.

typecheck.description: Run luau-lsp over the check artifact and report its type errors on the source lines.

definitions.description: Definitions files for the type check, `.d.luau` or `.d.aly`, relative to this file. The project's `.d.aly` files join them on their own. The editor loads the same list.

roblox_types.description: Load the Roblox globals. The file comes from the luau-lsp extension's storage, or downloads once into `~/.alloy/types`.

security_level.description: The security level of the Roblox globals.

luau_lsp.description: The luau-lsp binary. Unset means `luau-lsp` on the PATH, then `~/.alloy/bin` and `~/.ember/bin`.

new_solver.description: Run the checker's new solver. `false` runs the old one, which evaluates no type function, the way an editor on the old solver does.

too_many_arguments.description: `too_many_arguments` fires past this many parameters; `self` does not count.

too_many_lines.description: `too_many_lines` fires past this many lines in one function.

max_nesting.description: `deep_nesting` fires past this many nested blocks.

cognitive_complexity.description: `cognitive_complexity` fires past this score: one per branch, loop, `and`, `or`, and ternary, plus the depth of each branch.

roblox.title: [roblox]
roblox.description: What the place is like. `rig` picks the character type `Player.Character` reads as; the editor's `alloy-luau.rig` setting wins over it.

rig.description: The rig of a player's character. `Player.Character` types as `R15Character?` or `R6Character?`; `alloy doc R15Character` shows the parts.

test.title: [test]
test.description: Where `alloy test` writes the specs: one lest spec per source with a `@test`, with everything the tests reach. `alloy doc test` explains it.

out.description: The folder the specs land in, relative to this file. Each source with a `@test` writes `<out>/<path>.spec.luau`.

lest.description: Write `lest.toml` and the `@lest` alias of `.luaurc` when the root has none.

shim.description: Load engine doubles before each spec: `Vector3`, `Color3`, `Enum`, `task`, `game`, and a small Instance tree, so shared code runs on a plain VM. In Studio they do nothing.

fmt.title: [fmt]
fmt.description: How Anneal, `alloy fmt`, lays code out. The names follow larvae and stylua where the option is theirs; `alloy doc fmt` explains each.

recommended.description: Apply the recommended layout, the defaults below. Off, the formatter preserves what the file does: no line is reflowed, quotes and blank lines stay as written, and the indent comes from the file. The keys set here still apply over that.

column_width.description: The width a bracket group breaks past: a call, a table, or an array that does not fit goes one element per line.

line_endings.description: The line ending of the written file. `input` keeps the endings the file already uses.

indent_width.description: Spaces per level, when `indent_type` is spaces.

quote_style.description: The quotes of a string literal. An `auto` style keeps the other quote for a string that holds the preferred one; `force` escapes instead.

leading_zero.description: `.5` and `0.5`: add the zero, strip it, or leave the literal.

call_parentheses.description: The parentheses of a call with one string or one table argument: `f("x")` and `f "x"`. `input` keeps what the author wrote.

space_after_function_names.description: Where a space goes before the `(` of a function: `function f ()` in definitions, `f ()` in calls.

collapse_simple_statement.description: Whether `if c then return end` or a function with one statement may sit on one line.

block_newline_gaps.description: A blank line right after a block opener or right before its closer: dropped, or kept.

magic_trailing_comma.description: A trailing comma in the source keeps its group expanded, one element per line, whatever the width.

trailing_comma.description: An expanded table or array ends its last element with a comma.

space_inside_array.description: Alloy's own: `[ 1, 2 ]` rather than `[1, 2]` in an array literal.

align_struct_fields.description: Alloy's own: the `:` of a struct's fields line up.

expand_imports.description: Alloy's own: an `import { }` or `export { }` list with more than one name breaks one name per line. Off, a trailing comma in the list asks for the same.

exclude.description: Paths the formatter leaves alone. A `*` matches any run of characters: `"vendor/*"`, `"*.gen.aly"`.

call_chains.title: [fmt.call_chains]
call_chains.description: How a chain of method calls breaks.

style.description: `method` breaks before each call past the first, `full` before every call, once the chain holds `min_calls` calls. `preserve` keeps the author's lines.

min_calls.description: The number of calls a chain needs before it breaks; 0 breaks only what runs past the width.

sort_requires.title: [fmt.sort_requires]
sort_requires.description: Sorting of the `import` lines at the top of a file.

enabled.description: Sort the run of `import` statements at the top of the file by path.

grouping.description: `by-kind` orders `@alias` paths first, then absolute ones, then relative ones; `flat` sorts by path alone.

alx.title: [fmt.alx]
alx.description: The markup of `.alx` files, after luaux-worm. The code around it formats like any `.aly` file.

attribute_quotes.description: The quotes of a string attribute: `Name="x"`. `quote_style` does not govern it.

bracket_same_line.description: The `>` of a tag that broke its attributes sits on the last attribute's line rather than its own.

attribute_per_line.description: A tag that breaks its attributes puts every attribute on its own line, the way Prettier lays JSX out; `false` packs as many as fit.

text_wrap.description: `fill` reflows text children to the column width; `preserve` keeps the author's line breaks.

blank_lines.description: A blank line between two children stays.

project.title: [project]
project.description: The DataModel tree: which project file describes it, and what `alloy build` writes from it.

name.description: The name in the project files Alloy writes. A project file at the root carries its own name, which wins.

file.description: The Rojo or Argon project file to read, relative to this file. Unset means `default.project.json`, then the one `*.project.json` at the root. Its tree says where each folder lands; a `[mount]` table here wins over it.

runtime.description: Where `alloy.luau` lands, as `@game/Service/Folder`. Emitted code requires it by an instance path. Unset means the place the project file already gives it, then the node that mounts `[build] out`, then `@game/ReplicatedStorage/Alloy`.

source_of_truth.description: The `[mount]` table is the tree: `alloy build` writes `default.project.json` and `.alloy/build.project.json` from it. Off, Alloy writes neither file, and the table only rewrites an `@alias` require into an instance path in the ship artifact, for a sync tool that owns the tree itself.

mount_aliases.description: The `[mount]` table names aliases too: the compiler and the language server serve them beside the ones `.config.luau` or `.luaurc` declares, so `@shared/x` completes and resolves. A name in the Luau configuration wins. Off, only the Luau configuration names aliases.

sourcemap.description: Write `sourcemap.json` at the root on every build, the name Rojo and luau-lsp read. The language server reads it for `@game/` completion and instance types. On, the build writes over a `sourcemap.json` another tool wrote; off, it writes none.

std.title: [std]
std.description: How a file reaches the std. `alloy doc std` lists its modules.

globals.description: The std names a file writes with no import. `none` means a file imports each one, `import { HashMap } from "@alloy/std/collections"`; `all` makes every one ambient; a list makes those names ambient. `Future`, `Result`, `Ok`, `Err`, `Array`, and the operator traits need no import under any value, since a keyword or an operator writes them.

mount.title: [mount]
mount.description: Where each folder lands in the DataModel: `alias = [path, mount]`. A tool that reads a Rojo or Argon project file needs no table here; Alloy reads `default.project.json`. A tool with its own format describes the tree here, and this table then wins over any project file. With it, `alloy build` also writes `default.project.json` over the sources. `alias = path`, a bare string, names a folder another mount already carries and gives it an alias alone.

additionalProperties.description: A path and where it lands, or a path alone. The pair mounts the folder at a DataModel location; a `.server.` or `.client.` file name picks the script class, and `init` names its directory. A bare string is the alias-only form: the name serves as an alias for a folder another mount already carries, and the folder has to sit under one.

oneOf.description: The folder on disk, relative to this file, and the DataModel location.

items.description: The folder on disk, relative to this file.

oneOf.description: A folder another mount already carries, relative to this file. The name is an alias for it and nothing else.

ingots.title: [ingots]
ingots.description: The extensions of the project, name to source. An ingot is an executable beside an `ingot.toml`; it edits source before the desugar, lints, formats, and answers the editor. A path is read where it is; a repo is fetched by `alloy ingot install` into `.alloy/ingots` and recorded in `.alloy/ingots.lock`. `alloy doc ingots` explains them.

additionalProperties.description: Where the ingot comes from: a path relative to this file that holds `ingot.toml` and the binary, or a GitHub release. `alloy ingot install` fetches it; a build never does.

oneOf.description: A directory relative to this file.

path.description: A directory relative to this file.

repo.description: `owner/repo` on GitHub; the release `v<version>` holds the zip.

version.description: The release to install. `^`, the default, is the latest release at install time, and `.alloy/ingots.lock` records what it resolved to. A version, `1.2.3` or `v1.2.3`, pins that release, and `alloy ingot update` leaves it alone.

asset.description: The asset name in the release. Unset means `<name>-ingot-<target>.zip`, then `<name>-ingot.zip`.

order.description: The pass the ingot's transform runs in, over the manifest's word. A lower number runs first.

lints.description: Lints of this ingot switched on or off by name, over the manifest's defaults.

ingot.title: [ingot]
ingot.description: One table per ingot, `[ingot.<name>]`: its options, over the defaults its manifest declares.

additionalProperties.description: The options of one ingot, over the defaults its manifest declares. The key is the ingot's name under `[ingots]`; a key the manifest does not declare is an error.

alx.title: [alx]
alx.description: How `.alx` markup lowers: the factory it calls and the names it maps. The shape `luaux.toml` has, kept in this file so a project needs no second one; a `luaux.toml` beside it still reads when this table is empty. `alloy doc markup` explains the keys.

factory.title: [alx.factory]
factory.description: The functions the lowered markup calls. With no key set, the markup picks a UI library on its own; with any key set, it assumes nothing.

backend.description: The arrangement of a lowered element: `table` passes children in the props table, `element` as a third argument.

create.description: The expression that constructs an element, called with the class name.

children.description: The expression that attaches children, when the backend takes one.

event.description: The expression that connects an event handler.

compute.description: The expression that wraps a computed value.

use.description: The expression that reads a state value.

fragment.description: The expression that groups children without a parent.

interpolate.description: How `{expr}` in text lowers: `plain` inserts the value, `compute` wraps it.

merge.description: The expression that merges a spread props table.

elements.title: [alx.elements]
elements.description: Element name aliases: `Frame = "frame"` renames one class in markup, and `all = "camel"` renames every class by a scheme: PascalCase, camelCase, snake_case, or flatcase.

additionalProperties.description: The name markup uses for this class, or a casing scheme for `all`.

properties.title: [alx.properties]
properties.description: Property and event aliases: `Text = "text"` for every class, `all = "camel"` for a scheme, or a class table with its own.

additionalProperties.description: The name markup uses for this property in every class, or a table of aliases for one class.

lints.title: [alx.lints]
lints.description: Deprecated: the levels of the markup lints. Write `[lint.rules] alx.<name> = "allow" | "warn" | "deny"`.

static_conditional_child.description: Deprecated: write `[lint.rules] alx.static_conditional_child`. Markup in a child expression that no function encloses: it is built once, not on each render.
